system.description:
| #### Chained Cascade / Battle Amp / Your chakra surges outward in a relentless cascade. / Chained Empowerment. You gain a number of temporary Chakra equal to twice the Chain rank you benefitted from as part of the Bukijutsu cast with your Chained Cascade feature. These temporary chakra points dissipate when this state ends. / Cascading Chakra. You gain a rank of Mastery to your Ninjutsu attacks and a +1 bonus to your Ninjutsu save DC. / Protective Barrier. As a reaction to an allied creature within 10 feet of you taking damage you can transfer all remaining temporary hit points granted by Chained Cascade to them, allowing the transferred temporary hit points to be applied to the triggering damage. |

Beginning, at 6th level, your master of weaving ninjutsu into your Bukijutsu techniques allows you to unleash techniques in perfect succession.

When you cast a Ninjutsu of C-Rank or lower, as an Action, you can spend 3 Discipline to cast a Bukijutsu of the same rank as the triggering Ninjutsu at no additional action cost. Immediately after the Bukijutsu is cast you enter your Chained Cascade state until the end of your next turn. If you would enter this state again before it ends, its duration is extended by 1 round until the end of your following turn.

Beginning at 14th level, you can use this feature with Ninjutsu of B-Rank.
